correctness.rationale: The smoothing state contains the current term \((1-\beta_3)\eta_t\), so the clipped rate cannot fall below it; equality holds at the first step. On the scalar quadratic, source bias correction gives the exact first-step ratio \([1-(1-\beta_3)\alpha h/(h|x_0|+\varepsilon)]^2\), and the sharp frontier follows from solving \((1-K)^2\le1\).

value.rationale: AdaMod was introduced specifically to control unexpectedly large early adaptive rates without manual warmup. The attenuation floor identifies the exact fraction of any current spike that must survive the bound, while the quadratic theorem turns that structural fact into a sharp curvature-sensitive safety test and failure neighborhood.
